environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 instance with IAM instance profile 'UserRecordsFullAccess'. The attached IAM policy grants dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:UpdateItem, dynamodb:Scan on arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:*:table/UserRecords with no condition keys. Session management uses signed cookies with user_id set at login. No API gateway or proxy in front of the application.

config.runtime: EC2 t3.medium, Amazon Linux 2, Python 3.9, gunicorn
config.network: Public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 8080
